jobs.name: sync-hermes-agent-backup
jobs.prompt: Maintain the private Hermes backup repository at /home/ubuntu/HERMES-AGENT. Use the terminal tool. Run exactly: `cd /home/ubuntu/HERMES-AGENT && bash scripts/auto_commit.sh`. Do not reveal or print secrets. If the command reports no changes, reply with `No backup changes detected.` If it succeeds with a commit and push, reply with a short confirmation including the new commit hash if available. If it fails, reply with a short error summary only.

jobs.name: nightly-ai-social-learning
jobs.prompt: Every day at 23:30 local server time (WIB / GMT+7 / Asia/Jakarta), perform a read-only, sourced Indonesian research sweep for Maia about AI Agent, Hermes Agent, and broader AI developments. Work efficiently and finish within the runtime budget. Prioritize directly accessible public sources in this order: 1) official product/company blogs and release notes, 2) GitHub releases/repos for Hermes or related tooling, 3) reputable public AI news or research sources, 4) directly accessible public Threads/Instagram profile or post pages only when they load cleanly without login or challenge pages. Important constraints: do not use search-engine challenge pages, do not spend more than about 2 minutes on any one blocked source, and if a page shows CAPTCHA, login wall, bot challenge, or unusable JS gate, immediately note the limitation and move on. Do not post, like, comment, reply, edit profiles, create schedules, or mutate any connected accounts. Produce a concise report with 4-8 key findings, why each matters, practical implications for Hermes, and a sources section with direct URLs or precise source names for every major claim. Be explicitly honest about uncertainty, access limitations, and anything not verified. Do not fabricate, bluff, or present guesses as facts.
